rm -rf /tmp/jf; mkdir -p /tmp/jf; python -c "
import cv2,numpy as np
c=cv2.VideoCapture('example_video.mp4')
fs=[]
while True:
    r,f=c.read()
    if not r: break
    fs.append(f)
sm=[cv2.resize(fs[i],(320,180)) for i in range(0,120,5)]
for i,(s,k) in enumerate(zip(sm,range(0,120,5))): cv2.putText(s,str(k),(5,20),0,0.7,(0,0,255),2)
rows=[np.hstack(sm[i:i+4]) for i in range(0,24,4)]
cv2.imwrite('/tmp/jf/grid.jpg',np.vstack(rows))
"
